policies.name: Users can create their own attendance
Users can update their own attendance
Users can join chats as themselves
Attendees can create check-in requests
policies.with_check:
((requester_profile_id = current_profile_id()) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM attendance a1
  WHERE ((a1.meetup_id = check_in_requests.meetup_id) AND (a1.profile_id = check_in_requests.requester_profile_id) AND (a1.status <> 'cancelled'::attendance_status)))) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM attendance a2
  WHERE ((a2.meetup_id = check_in_requests.meetup_id) AND (a2.profile_id = check_in_requests.target_profile_id) AND (a2.status <> 'cancelled'::attendance_status)))))

Friends can view their own friendships

Host reads their meetup location history
policies.qual:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM meetups m
  WHERE ((m.id = meetup_location_changes.meetup_id) AND (m.host_id = current_profile_id()))))
